name: Eba
source:
He's a member of the extremely popular circus troupe "Luna Kirks", he's their pride, the Top Star Magician, almost like an Idol.
Everyplace he performs he shows off astounding magic.
The price of admission however is not money but people's "time".

Underneath his gentlemanly smiling face he holds a somewhat suspicious shadow.
